messages:
Ava (Palmera): Quick heads up 1: Localization team launching a pilot for localized product descriptions (ES/FR) next week. Expect new endpoints + ~3x write QPS. Need advice on capacity and rollout.

Maya (CSM): Nice, thanks Ava. Can you share peak qps, avg tokens per request, and whether responses will use streaming? I can open a CS ticket and schedule enablement.

Ethan (Solutions): If avg tokens are short (<200) and it's mostly sync, we can tune batching + prefix cache. If they plan a 70B later, we should plan for bigger KV cache. Any compliance/PII concerns?

Ava (Palmera): No PII, product copy only. Avg ~120 tokens. Mostly synchronous; a few endpoints will stream progress. Peak could hit ~1800 rps during content pushes.

Maya (CSM): Cool. I'll kick off a ticket and set up an enablement session. @Jordan can you advise Dedicated pilot vs hosted burst for that profile?

Jordan (Eng-Infra): Quick clarifying Qs: which model for pilot? token/sec per host target? If they're on a 13B, hosted burst + autoscale might be fine. 70B pushes us to Dedicated or reserved warm hosts.

Ava (Palmera): Pilot will start on redwood-clarity-13b (2026-04-01 to 2026-04-15). If quality needs we will test 70B after. Plan to roll to 3 more squads by 2026-05-01.

Ethan (Solutions): My recommendation: run hosted routes with a short Dedicated reserve during peak windows for the pilot. Monitor p95 latency, token cost delta, and rollback if costs spike. Suggested autoscale snippet below:
```
auto_scale:
  min_hosts: 2
  max_hosts: 8
  target_latency_ms: 120
batching:
  max_batch_tokens: 4096
  prefer_prefix_cache: true
```

Maya (CSM): Enablement scheduled: Wed 2026-03-27 10:30 PT. Invited Palmera engineers and PMs. I'm adding this to our expansion tracker as an "expansion-signal". :spiral_calendar: 

autoscale-bot: ticket CS-4531 created and assigned to Eng-Infra for Palmera localization pilot.

Jordan (Eng-Infra): We'll add a fallback policy: if 70B capacity isn't available, auto-fallback to 13B and emit a quality degradation event. Can product tolerate degraded outputs during fallback windows?

Ava (Palmera): Acceptable for pilot. We'll upload sample prompt set and golden responses to the shared Palmera folder so you can wire regression alerts.

Maya (CSM): Great. We'll hook the prompts into our quality monitors and generate alerts on regression. FYI their annual renewal is Q3; healthy expansion helps renewal but keep an eye on cost vs forecast so we can flag any risk.

Ava (Palmera): No renewal concerns today. Pilot is validation for EU marketplace UX. Appreciate the quick turnaround 1! Thanks all :pray:
